title: MODE 3: BASE (Bases and Logic)
summary: Convert among BIN, OCT, DEC, HEX and apply bitwise logical operators on integers.

body.text: MODE 3 is BASE (the mode menu prints BASE, not BASE-N). Use the green DEC, HEX, BIN, and OCT keys to set the working base. Values are integers; binary logic is 10-bit.
In BASE, hex A–F are the green letters on (-) = A, °′″ = B, hyp = C, sin = D, cos = E, tan = F. Press those keys unshifted. ALPHA A is variable A and will not type hex A.
In BASE the X key opens LOGIC (and, or, xor, xnor, Not, Neg, and d/h/o/b prefixes). Binary Not and Neg use a 10-bit word.

body.label: Pitfall
body.text: Fractions, EXP, and most scientific functions are not valid in BASE. Return to COMP for floating-point work.
